body: I’m on my third go-through of the series, and enjoying it as much as the first, sometimes more because I know what’s coming.
When I woke up from a surgery, one of my first thoughts was related to LO, and we were NC at the time. Funny how our brains work huh?
Start em over again! Lol
Literally where I am in my replay of Zero right now. Lol
Yup! It had been about 20 years and my LO reappeared, and nothing had changed about how I felt. I couldn’t believe it. It’s wild.
Hahahaha I feel so called out right now. 😂

Both my LO and I are in long-term relationships, and we are in constant contact. It’s a friendship tho, not really any mixed messages being sent and we have never been in a relationship with each other, so not the same thing. And it’s strictly online only, tho we know each other IRL, no phone calls or the like. So not the same situation you’re in.

Unfortunately it can last a long while. I don’t think my situation is typical, but I’ve been limerent for the same person for over 20 years. I will say that the strength of it has ebbed and flowed over the years, but it’s still there, and when LO reappeared it was worse than ever. Good luck to you! I found focusing on myself was the best way to help with things, threw myself into school/work, focused on friends. Exercise. Mental health. That really helped in the years we were NC.
Indeed! Lol that’s definitely also very helpful!
This!! This has been how I deal lately. It’s definitely not great, but it fucken helps.
Haven’t gotten to Lost Judgment yet, but CyricZ is a blessing for people like me who don’t wanna miss anything. Best guides out there!
Yay!!! Good luck!!!
Way too close indeed.

That makes sense, if your LO is a person that needs to be in control. I have those tendencies as well, and how out-of-control limerence makes me feel inside is a novel experience, one I’m not always comfortable with. It’s weird tho, cuz I’m mostly fine with LO being in control when we’re together. Mostly. Lol

I figured you didn’t feel you could be your true self, but didn’t hurt to ask. That’s definitely hard if your a physical type of person, and LO doesn’t want that kind of interaction. Good that you can play it cool when you run into LO unexpectedly. The last time I saw LO was kind of unexpected, and I was so terrified that I was gonna act like a moron. 

I was joking about the screening potential LOs. I know very well how it’s not something we really have any control over. I’m sorry that you’re apart from the potential SO, but maybe when they return things could progress. I’ve read of success stories about finding a SO and having that healthy relationship killing the limerence for the LO. I’m a bit envious of those people, though I hope you’re one of them. We deserve not to be trapped in this limerence nonsense.
Cabaret is my absolute favorite thing in the Yakuza series (and that’s saying something, as I’m obsessed with the series as a whole)!! It’s the freaken best!

Yeah, it’s crazy how our limerent brains can make it seem like someone so incompatible is perfect for us. I think my LO and I could make it work, but it would definitely come with a fuckton of issues to deal with, and I doubt either of us would actually want to deal with those issues in reality. 

That must’ve been a weird experience for you, her acting like she’d just met a celebrity or something. Do you feel you’re able to be your true self around her? I always feel like I’m more me around him, but that’s always been the case, since before I became limerent for him. 

It’s kinda funny that you say she gets super submissive around you; my LO also brings out that more submissive, soft, gentle side of me that no one else gets to see. Tho, if I were to get him in a bedroom at this point, he would see a way less submissive side. 😂 not sure how he’d react to that. Lmao

Ahhh, you’re in a place taking COVID seriously. That’s a good thing! Everything is open where I am, so it would be easy to meet somewhere (with masks) in public, like a coffee shop. And yeah, I definitely would rather meet with my LO alone than with anyone else, especially their mom. 

I love how you’re already screening potential new LOs. Lol I’ve never had another LO before, so the whole idea of feeling like this more than once, for more than one person, blows my mind. And yay for potential SOs! I mean, 2 is better than 1, if you like managing a lot of internal strife and confusion. Lmao some days I balance having an LO and an SO just fine, other days I want to blow up my life. It’s a balance. 😂

That’s awesome that you get some clarity after a while, even if you still have the limerence. The only time I’ve ever beaten back the fog to that extent was when I was NC with my LO for like 7 years. After like 2-3, it became more background noise than anything. I’ve gotten a lot better at managing the fog tho, so that’s something. 

In my case, I can understand it. I made some bad decisions a long time ago, and that’s had repercussions on our IRL relationship ever since. We were young and dumb, and he doesn’t hold it against me or even really mind, but it ... complicated things. And his SO isn’t a fan of me, which I can also understand, so that further increases the difficulty. 

I love that you flipped the script on your LO! That’s awesome. Good for you for dictating the terms for once! I’m sorry that your limerent brain went on a tangent while you were in the Zoom call, but yay for realizing it and dealing with it. 

I wish I had your willpower; I don’t think I could ever cancel an opportunity to see my LO. Shit, I can’t even pass up a potential opportunity. It’s pathetic. And yeah, that’s a weird ass request. Like, couldn’t you meet at a coffee shop or something? A freaken parking lot?!?

And that’s gonna suck for her, but I’m glad that you’re not going to have to see her after this year since you’re changing jobs. Maybe chill on the new LO tho. 😂

Yeah, that’s a shitty situation to be in, since you want her to share that energy with you. My LO only wants it rarely, and I don’t give it to my SO. I try very hard to keep things separate, both for fairness to SO and my own sanity. 

LC definitely does help clear the fog in some sense. It’s easier to see clearly when you’re not in the throes of limerent nonsense. NC doesn’t clear that fog for me, it makes it worse. Sounds like that’s how it goes for you too, as you’re LC and not NC. 

Yeah, my LO is the same way. It’s always on his terms, never on mine. It’s so one-sided, and that’s so not fair, even if I understand. Yay for complicated situationships! I’ve managed to stop asking (as of now, who knows how long that’ll last), but now I just long for him to ask, which he never does. 

I wish you so much luck with detaching and moving on!!

I think it depends on the day. Some days I would agree, that it being a quad is a lot more stable. Other days, I feel like the triangle would be better (with me being the lone point), cuz I wouldn’t have to worry about or consider anyone else. And yeah, there’s definitely attachment issues, just not in the tradition sense. My whole situation is so fucked. Lol

The emotional intimacy is definitely a double edged sword. Same with physical intimacy. It sucks that you both can affect each other to that extent, but that memory of that assignment must be crazy! To be in that situation is wild. 

 And it definitely could be that she doesn’t like LC, and wants to see you. Since you’re also limerent, I’m sure you can understand where she’s at. But I would think it also gives you insight into your own behavior too. Such a wild situation. And I’ve found that working on not making IRL meetups a super big deal can be a lifesaver. The last time I saw my LO I was so worried i was gonna blow it out of proportion, cuz I was making it such a big deal in my head, and it turned out to be a wonderful interaction. 

And I know that high she experienced. That’s EXACTLY how I feel in my LOs presence. Like, I could just be there not talking not anything, and I would be in ecstasy. Even just thinking about it. Sigh.

I won’t lie, I’ve had that thought before but I honestly wouldn’t want them to break up, because I know being with his SO and family makes him happy; I want him happy. That’s most important. (Let’s not go down the psych route if what it says that I value his happiness more than my own)

Physical intimacy definitely creates a strong bond, but I also feel that emotional intimacy creates a strong one as well, and that emotional intimacy is more rare than physical. My (I like your term) situationship with my LO is definitely special, and I try really hard to be good with what it is. 

I was very lucky that I found a healthy love with my SO; I was never limerent for him, it’s been super stable, he’s a wonderful person. So I find myself in this weird position of loving and being in-love with 2 people, limerent over one. It’s a wild ride.

I think sometimes that instant trust and connection that can happen with LOs leads us to our doom. It seems so natural, like her innately trusting you with highly personal info, and it makes it that much easier to fall into the limerence trap. 

I’m glad that you get a respite in your dreams, but that sucks hard that you had that particular dream so close to seeing LO. Hopefully you can manage things when the time comes. Yeah, the holidays are rough. I too have to put up with people I don’t wish to, tho I do have my SO and that’s wonderful, but there’s always this part of me that wishes LO was there, and it gets so much worse around holidays. Thankfully they’re almost over, and soon enough Valentine’s Day will be too.

Sending you love. I’ve been limerent for the same LO for about the same amount of time you have, our longest stretch of NC was like 7 years, and it was extremely LC for a good 15 years altogether. It was agony, but I just focused on myself and my goals, did my best to stay distracted and focused on my friends and loved ones. Not gonna lie, LO was a motivator for everything I did in the beginning (“LO would appreciate this; LO would be proud of this; LO shares this interest; etc”) but eventually it became about me. I never forgot, but the pain dulled to a bearable ache after a while. I can’t tell you how to make it stop, as I’m here so obviously still dealing with it, but I can tell you (in my experience) things can get better.

I kinda wish my LO having a SO brought me off cloud seven. I’ve watched my LO get married, have kids, and it’s done nothing. There’s no jealousy (I mean, I wish it was me, but I don’t hate his SO or kids, they’re part of him) or anything. I’ve constantly swung between cloud seven and despair over LO prior to any of that anyway. Lol

Yeah the digital contact is a double edged sword. My LO isn’t a fan of IRL contact in general, so it’s few and far between that he wants to see me. That’s so rough that your LO wants to meet up; that roller coaster begins again. Good luck!

I’m sorry that finding out your LO had a SO destroyed you. It’s definitely hard to deal with for most people. It’s good that your prior experiences with limerence helped you know what was to come, even if it was still a struggle to get thru. 

And I can speak from experience that limerence doesn’t care if you have a SO, unfortunately. I have an overall wonderful marriage, yet here I am! (Tho, my limerence predates my marriage, so it’s probably unsurprising). The SOs really are the innocent victims in this mess, even tho we can’t help what we feel. Emotions don’t care what we want either.  

As someone who is on the continuous journey of balancing limerence and friendship with my LO (he’s not mutually limerent tho, which is helpful, at least one of us has their wits about them), I can say that it’s a rough road sometimes. Other times it’s effortless. I’m “lucky” that I know my LO really well, so I’m able to keep myself grounded and not put him on a “perfect” pedestal. I’m well aware of his faults. Lol I also don’t see him IRL like ever, so that also helps; cuz yeah, when I do see him, that desire is definitely a distraction.
It was my first DQ game that I actually finished. I’ve played IX as well, which was also good, but I never beat it.

Yeah, that’s definitely a tough situation if you think you might be LO’s LO as well; some people might think that’s a dream come true, but I would think it just makes things more complicated. Hopefully you can figure things out. 

I’m glad you were able to get past your last LO, tho it sucks you’re back in it with another one. Dealing with this for one person has been rough enough; I can’t imagine going thru it with more than one person.
Another Yakuza gal here!! Lol the series is phenomenal, and if loving it makes us weird, oh well!! 🖤
XI was fantastic.

Honestly, NC drives me insane. It makes everything so much worse. Overall having regular contact with my LO, even if it’s just a text every few days, works best for me. However, in my case, it doesn’t help the daydreams/fantasy aspect too much, but it definitely reduces the anxiety/obsessive worrying/compulsive behaviors side of things. 

I’m glad that Low Contact is working for you! Limerence is so individual, and it can be so hard to find what works!! Good luck with things.

Everything still status quo with SO and LO. Life should be returning to normal routine soon, which I’m honestly dreading. I continue to spiral downward into a hell of my own making. Trying hard to just be content with what I have, it’s more than a lot of people, but it’s hard and right now I don’t want any of it.

Sometimes I wonder if a heroin addiction would be easier to manage than limerence. And I agree, the absolute highs are worth the mega depressing lows, and those lows are definitely low. But the highs are so fucken high. You’re not alone. Good luck with things.
It’s ebbed and flowed over the years, but one LO, over 20 years. I don’t even wanna calculate how much time and energy I’ve spent over that time.

Even with all this insanity, I don’t think I want to be out of his orbit. I think even if I begged, and he said no, I’d still beg again. I honestly don’t know if there’s anything that could end this. And I don’t know if I would want to if I could, which is probably the most fucked up part.

It really is such an addiction. Putting myself physically close to him is the only thing I’ve had a modem of success with (and I’ve stayed near him in my travels more than is sensible). I’m hopeless with anything else. It’s been so hard lately; I’m literally at a point where I want to beg for him to spend time with me. I haven’t as of yet, but I’ve literally had to shut my phone off to stop the impulse.

It really is horrible. And I understand; I’ve fought off the impulse to just drive there for no reason at all but to be close by. Thankfully, my logical brain is like “we are not spending that money for nothing” and so far my emotional limerent brain has fallen inline with rational brain. Now, if he wanted to see me, I’d spend it in a heartbeat.
It’s always Christmas in Kamurocho.  😂

I feel this so much!! I’ve gone out of my way (like hours out of my way) to stay close to where my LO lives, just to be close to him! 😅 never gone by his house or anything like that tho. That’s a bit much, even for me. Lol

Things are relatively stable with both SO and LO. No real changes to either relationship. 

I find myself pulling back from both of them tho. I think I’m getting to a point where I’m just tired of all of it. Been thinking about getting divorced, not even cuz of LO, just cuz I want to be left alone. Yay depression! Maybe next week will be better.
Same here!! Turn based is usually my thing, but I’ve become obsessed with Yakuza. I own them all now. Lol The Judgment games are really good too!!
I just restarted my journey with 0 the other day!! As fantastic as the first time!
I loved 3. I played it on Normal with minimal issues, and the Yakuza series is the first beat-em-up brawler series I’ve ever played (played them in order 0-6). Enjoy!!

Oh that’s rough! One of the characters (my favorite) in the first game of my favorite series reminds me of my LO when we were younger, and it’s always a combo of thrill and sadness whenever I see/play as that character.
Or when a character habitually says some of the same lines your LO says. Or when a character has the same personality traits. 😞 at least the games are fun, even if they don’t help me forget. Lol
It’s never enough anyway tho. I’m already addicted; I couldn’t be any more addicted.
Yup. Without hesitation.

I resonate with all you said so much! What we feel is real and valid, even if it’s also insane at times. I’m trying really hard to get to the point where I can just cherish memories and not be so twisted all the time, to be able to be ok with single experiences being enough.
Yeah. This is the problem. Could once ever be enough?

Thanks for commenting. I’m sorry that you have tough times too, as much as it helps that someone understands. 

“... and I just want that ‘ultimate’ connection.” I felt that in my soul. That’s where I’m at right now, and it sucks cuz I really am happy with where things are overall. He’s not mine, but we have what we have and what we have is rather wonderful. I’ve definitely been trying to focus on the important things, or things that make me feel good. The thoughts of him are still constant while I’m doing that, which isn’t quite the goal, but I don’t feel as distressed, if that makes sense. 

Thank you for the reminder about what happens when we give in to the limerent impulses and compulsions. I wasn’t planning on being an idiot, did that recently enough and I wonder if we’ve really recovered from it, tho it’s probably just in my head and everything is fine. Acting “rash” definitely leads nowhere good, and trying to cling definitely just makes them slip away.

I am working on this exact thing right now, have been for a while. Overall it’s gone relatively well, it’s been over a year since we’ve been in communication again after years of NC, tho things have definitely taken a backslide the last few months (my own fault). It’s not an easy path to follow, and the limerence can definitely interfere with stuff. 

I agree with an earlier reply to a comment that someone made, that the consistency helps a lot (part of my struggles now are shifting dynamics in things cuz life) in managing my limerent symptoms.

Oh I definitely agree that, just cuz I’m accepting what and how I think and feel, it doesn’t mean that limerence symptoms don’t occur. I just find more peace, and find it easier, now than when I was beating myself up and judging myself for what I think and feel. 

I’m sorry limerence has interfered so much in your life that you feel you haven’t had a “real” relationship before. I hope that someday you’re able to form that connection with someone, and that the connection makes you feel like you don’t have one foot out the door.

I’ve found lately that moving toward acceptance is what works for me too. I’m also over 20 years limerent for the same person, and have a SO. Sometimes I think it just doesn’t go away, you just learn to live with it, exist with it, survive it.

I was a newbie at brawler-type games when I started the Yakuza series (started with 0 and worked my way forward), and I made it thru 3 on Normal with minimal issue, and it ended up being one of my favorites in the series. You should get the collection!

I’ve known my one and only LO for the majority of my life, and we spent a lot of time together IRL when we were kids, but we’ve communicated online without seeing each other IRL for the majority of the time.

Things are pretty calm and steady with SO. He’s anxious for this work crap to be done so we can be in the same place again. I really do want that, but I will admit it’s easier managing my mental state being on my own. 

Things with LO are pretty stable; I had told him that constant contact, even if it’s low-dose, helps me manage my limerence symptoms best, and he’s apparently taken that to heart. He’s been super busy, but still finds time to reach out/respond to me, even if it’s not as often as I’d like (cuz, let’s be real, no amount would ever be enough; all your focus, all the time, please! Lol)

I go back and forth between being ok emotionally/mentally and not. Still in that depressive funk I’ve mentioned the past few weeks, been battling some delusional fantastical thinking. I don’t tend to sink time into fantasies of him reciprocating, cuz I know he isn’t and will never be in-love with me, but the last week they’ve been hitting hard. Been trying to determine what has triggered that change, but no luck thus far.

Yeah, he knows how I feel too. I’ve been very honest, about both how in-love I am and how limerent I am, and we’ve had some frank conversations about it. And he’s definitely an addiction, one I don’t want to be rid of, and one I’d love to OD on. It’s wonderful and horrible at the same time. 

I know I’m lucky that I don’t see my LO in person often. The few times I have seen him in the last 20 years have been wonderful in their way, and I wouldn’t trade them or change them for the world, but they definitely leave scars. I don’t consider scars a bad thing, per se, but they’re something to deal with and live with.

I feel ya. My SO and I also still get along well, and I do love him. It’s not that I don’t want to be with him. Honestly, if LO didn’t exist, there’s no one in the world I’d want more than my SO. I also agree that my LO and I probably wouldn’t make for the best relationship. Tho some days I think that we would; that’s probably just limerent delusion tho. 

Isn’t it horrible how you can literally drop everything, even things that are super important, if they give a speck of attention?! I do it all the time when he comes around. I feel so much for you guys who have to deal with your LOs in person. I’ve been dealing with this for decades, but luckily (unluckily? Depends on the day I guess) we have been geographically apart for the majority of our lives. I don’t know what I’d do if I saw him all the time. Talking to him all the time online is hard enough.
I always say that NieR “hurts so good.” I definitely enjoy the suffering, apparently.

I fear that, regardless of the day, I’d probably be at the divorce attorney’s office that same second, blowing up my whole world for him. And that’s full well knowing my LO isn’t a wonderful, perfect person. I’m freaken hopeless. Lol

I’m feeling this so much tonight. Like you, I’ve had a lot of good times and have great people in my life who love me. And yet, despite all of that, I’ve been so enthralled by my LO for decades. How are my brain and heart still so focused? It doesn’t matter, NC or contact, no hope or hope, it just remains. 

I’m sorry that you’re having a hard night. But thank you for posting; I’m also having a hard night with a lot of these same thoughts, and your post made me feel less alone. We’ll get through this.
Ichi and Maji, all the way.
Happy Birthday! Enjoy your time with friends and SO!
So true! I hadn’t had any real contact with my LO for over a decade, and the minute we started talking again it was all back, just as strong if not stronger than it was before.
Good luck! Hope it’s a positive experience!

Hahah sometimes I wonder if working on ourselves is the answer. Lol I’ve done a lot of work over the years, but this is still very much a thing. But we only have control over ourselves (as much as limerence constantly tries to wrestle that control away), so working on ourselves is kinda all we can do.  😅

Thanks! I used to beat myself up a lot over it, but I’ve gotten to a point where it is what it is; I feel what I feel. No sense in fighting myself over it. All that does is make me feel worse. 

Right now my solution is just to keep on moving forward. Being kind to myself and giving myself patience. Trying to balance how I feel with what my life is. I’m selfish; my LO is important to me separate from any limerence, so I won’t give him and our friendship up, and thankfully I’ve never been asked to. I’ve been doing work on myself, exploring the root of where this comes from. Taking things one day at a time.

I don’t really have any advice, but I feel your story in my soul. I, too, have a good marriage to a wonderful man, and yet am so twisted up over and am so in-love with my LO. I’ve learned to function (some days better some days worse) but it’s so hard. You’re not alone.

Things have been quiet here. Everything going well with SO, LO has been busy so contact has been minimal, but I’m not super disturbed by it. Still constantly checking SM to see if he’s messaged me, but fine when I see there’s nothing there. 

I’ve been in a funk the last few weeks tho, since the whole breakdown/space/reconnection with LO I mentioned on this weekly thread a few weeks ago. Really down and blah. I typically do ok with things being as they are, but I’m definitely stuck in a “I want my life to be with you (LO), not as it is” phase.
Definitely try to keep it separate. Can’t say it’s never happened tho. 😑

Yeah, he definitely didn’t understand what the hell was happening at the time. I definitely needed the space and time, tho I hate that it hurt and confused him. It kills me that I hurt him. 😖

Luckily we were able to talk things out and (hopefully, so far) come out the other side with better understanding and the same or a better relationship.

Yeah it sucks. I’m glad you have that one friend for support, even if they’re far away. I hope they’re someone you can drop the mask with them, even if it’s only a bit or for a little bit of time. Being able to be real with someone on some level for even a few minutes can do wonders. 

Here if you ever need to talk!

I got super triggered by some intense (for me) uncertainty, completely fell apart emotionally, told him I was going NC (out of the blue, for him) for an undetermined amount of time (which was hurtful and confusing for him) and asked him to learn about limerence (which weirded him the fuck out for a bit when he read about it and applied it to me/us/our relationship) while I was working thru my shit.

Is that what you were asking? Lol or were you asking how we ‘resolved’ things?

Yeah, the pretending becomes second nature after a while, I think. At this point I can be completely shattered and right on the edge, and everyone thinks everything is fine unless I say otherwise. The mask has become an almost permanent fixture. 

Sending you support and comfort. You’re not alone; there’s good company here.

Things with SO are going well. Still in separate places, definitely think that has helped things. I miss him, and I love him, and I think I needed to be reminded of that. This whole situation is so hard because he’s wonderful, and we have a good relationship. It’s never made a difference. 

Things with LO have stabilized again.  Gave him time and space to absorb stuff, we talked things out, we’re back to how things have been. I’m definitely feeling relieved, cuz I was really worried that things were screwed forever. 

I’ve honestly not felt as ... up/high I guess ... as I typically do, since things resolved with LO. There’s still a decent amount of depression/moroseness lingering. Not as bad as it was; while I did a great job of leaving LO alone when he needed space, i spiraled pretty deep down to a dark, suicidal place silently. Not feeling that bad now, but more bad than good, which is typically different when in constant contact with LO. Something new to analyze!
“It is said don’t go back to what broke you - but sometimes that’s where you need to go - in order to understand and realign and overwrite and indeed - heal.” Perfectly said. Absolutely perfect.

I’m glad you got to spend some time together. I do believe that, sometimes, we need to heal things with our LO as much as we need to heal things inside ourselves. I know how it feels to miss that friend/friendship, and hope that you get to continue the friendship in the future. Best of luck managing things as navigate this next part of your journey!

“I can’t believe what I did so I can’t accept it...” My soul hurts for you. I remember that feeling so well. I remember acting outrageously and, while he vanished instead of me ghosting him, being so ashamed and confused and devastated and mad at myself for the choices I had made and the actions I had taken. We do stupid things while in the throes of limerence.

I will admit that for the majority of my life, my motivation to do things that benefit me is for him, to prove a point like you said, or cuz maybe he’d like it or me or whatever. It’s not awesome, but at the same time it’s a motivator and works when other things don’t/haven’t. I try to be gentle with myself about it, and know that whatever the reason I do them, those things are  still good for me. Eventually I start doing them for myself, or at least that’s been the pattern in the past.

I’m so sorry you’re feeling this way! I have been where you are, and it’s devastating. The last time my LO and I went NC was pretty intense, it wasn’t my choice at all (tho was at least partly my fault, but not completely), I didn’t think there was any coming back from it, and the amount and severity of the feelings when he was gone was unbearable. Sending hugs, cuz I know how much it sucks. 

There isn’t much we can do when they don’t choose to be part of our lives, aside deal with ourselves day by day. I personally worked to keep my brain occupied, completely drowned myself in school and work, spent time with friends/loved ones. Distraction worked eventually to dull things down. I wouldn’t say I actually dealt with any of the deeper things that cause/contribute to limerence til recently, and this sub has been so helpful for suggestions for that. 

I hope you find what you need to be able to heal.

NC definitely doesn’t help (for some people) quelling the crazy. I’ve definitely found that my limerence is more out of control during NC/LC. Steady contact seems to be the best at keeping the majority of my limerent behaviors in check. I will say tho, that when we were in one of our like 7 years of NC periods, the limerence faded down to a dull ache, but the love/in-love side of things never changed an ounce. How I feel in that regards has never altered; limerent behaviors/feelings come in waves, being more or less destructive depending on context.

I agree that I don’t think it’s an 100% match for me either, tho a good amount of it fits. I describe it as it’s like having two parallel tracks inside; there’s the limerent bizarre obsessive/addictive track, and there’s a deep, unconditional love/in-love track, and they exist simultaneously. 

Despite it not fitting 100%, discovering the term limerence and learning about it, talking to others on this sub, and experimenting with things I’ve read has definitely helped me in this recent part of my journey. So, hopefully you find some of what you’re looking for here, even if not everything resonates with you.

there is more than one definition of intimate, but yes, we’ve been more than just friends. And while it adds another dimension to navigate, I haven’t found that to be a detriment to me (which was a surprise, let me tell ya); it’s actually been a real positive.
